title: SafePay ransomware targets over 600 critical infrastructure groups
excerpt: CISA and the FBI report that the SafePay ransomware gang has breached more than 600 critical infrastructure organizations globally.
body_html:
The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) reports that the SafePay ransomware operation has successfully breached more than 600 critical infrastructure organizations around the world.

According to the advisory, these attacks have targeted various entities globally since 2024. Security and law enforcement agencies are continuing to monitor and respond to the ongoing threat posed by the SafePay gang.
